claims.description: One claim per task the message is about. Merge several statements about the same task into one claim. [] if the message is not about work.

finish.description: New finish date YYYY-MM-DD, only if the message names a date/weekday (copy it from the calendar). Else null.

days_left.description: Days of work still needed from today ('2 more days' = 2). Only if no date is named. Else null.

detail.description: delayed/blocked/unblocked: the cause. modified: the requested change. Else null.
